skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role of communication in a globalized and unpredictable world
Apply communication skills in business contexts such as recruitment, negotiation, and business presentations
Effectively communicate in group settings and manage group dynamics
Develop cultural sensitivity and improve cross-cultural communication skills
Confidently present research findings and business presentations
Analyze and solve business communication problems
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations
Demonstrate initiative and confidence in communication tasks
Enhance emotional intelligence and adaptability in business communication
